run_inference: run inference on a single benchmark system with optional warmup and timed iterations to measure QPS and GPU memory
compare_results: compare candidate inference predictions against a baseline result and compute energy, force, and stress error metrics
format_report_table: format benchmark results dictionary as a human-readable table with energy error, force MAE, QPS, and GPU memory columns
run_PerfCheckRunner: run a PerfCheckRunner benchmark that compares candidate inference settings against an fp64 baseline across multiple systems
review_InferenceResult: review the InferenceResult dataclass that holds energy, forces, stress predictions and optional performance metrics from inference
